`test/lib/rules/indent.js` has two tests that are all but certainly missing intended newline characters. Here's the current code with comments added annotaing the issue:

``` js
        {
            code:
            "class Foo\n" +
            "  extends Bar {\n" +
            "  baz() {}" +  // <- Newline almost certainly intended on this line...
            "}",
            parserOptions: { ecmaVersion: 6 },
            options: [2]
        },
        {
            code:
            "class Foo extends\n" +
            "  Bar {\n" +
            "  baz() {}" + // <- ...and this one too!
            "}",
            parserOptions: { ecmaVersion: 6 },
            options: [2]
        }
```
